# Flying Wonders - Destination Management Company (DMC) & Travel Specialist

> Flying Wonders Private Limited is a premier Destination Management Company (DMC) based in Singapore and Bangalore, India. Specializing in Singapore & South East Asia inbound travel, Karnataka & South India bespoke tours, Singapore Educational Tours & Academic Immersions (K-12, College, MBA), B2B travel agent wholesale rates, instant attraction e-ticketing, visa consulting, and luxury corporate MICE arrangements.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Singapore & SE Asia DMC**: Direct ground handling, private airport transfers (Changi Airport SIN), hotel wholesale allotments, and licensed tour guide arrangements.
- **Singapore Educational Tours & Study Circuits**: Curated academic immersions for Schools (Grades 6–12), Engineering Colleges, and MBA Business Schools visiting Singapore Science Centre, Singapore Discovery Centre, Marina Barrage, SUTD, SMU, NTU, and NUS. 1:10 complimentary chaperone ratio with comprehensive student travel insurance and dietary support (Halal, Pure Veg, Jain).
- **B2B Travel Agent Network**: Instant B2B nett rates, custom white-label itineraries, API ticket delivery, and zero-fee INR/SGD settlements via UPI and corporate banking.
- **Attraction Ticketing**: Official wholesale e-tickets for Universal Studios Singapore, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore Night Safari, S.E.A. Aquarium, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, and Marina Bay Sands Skypark.
- **Cross-Border Travel**: Seamless private transfers between Singapore and Johor Bahru / Desaru / Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia).
- **Karnataka & South India Tours**: Curated heritage tours (Hampi, Badami), wildlife safaris (Kabini, Nagarhole, Bandipur), and luxury hill station retreats (Coorg, Chikmagalur).
- **Corporate & MICE**: End-to-end event planning, conference logistics, team retreats, and study tours in Singapore.
